company.name: doo GmbH
company.description:
doo is a Smart Event Automation Platform for digitizing corporate events, trade fairs and conferences. doo automates and personalizes the entire attendee journey - from invitation management and event marketing through registration and live tracking at the event. The intelligent event CRM learns the interests and typical behavior of attendees to increase the event ROI.

We offer a flexible white label solution for online registrations in order to automate management of event attendees. Moreover, our software supports your event marketing efforts by means of a free integrated newsletter and campaign tool.

With doo’s event analytics you and your events will be more successful than ever before. You can measure your marketing channels’ performance and leverage the number of participants through continuous improvements to your campaigns. We offer help with automated big data analyses and recommendations derived from them.

As the only provider offering analysis of drop-outs in the purchasing process, you have the possibility to win them back to attend your event. See for yourself and take a glance at doo - Smart Event Automation Platform!

https://doo.net/en
